title: He Seemed to Want MERCY... Then the Documents Said Strangled #history #art
description:
Peter the Great Interrogating the Tsarevich Alexei was painted by Nikolai Ge in 1871 and hangs in the Tretyakov Gallery. Documents published by Alexander Herzen said Alexei was strangled by order of Peter; Ge wrote that after the documents there could be no sympathy for Peter.
